page: Google Cloud Platform n4a-standard-4 is an Arm-based general-purpose server instance. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the arm64 architecture, paired with 16.0 GB of system memory. This configuration provides a balanced memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU.

The instance does not include local NVMe storage or bundled GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Additionally, the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Utilizing the arm64 architecture, the n4a-standard-4 is designed for qualitative cost efficiency, offering a favorable performance-per-watt and resource density profile for general-purpose workloads. It is suitable for web serving, application hosting, microservices, and lightweight containerized environments that do not require specialized hardware acceleration or local storage.
